due_when.clears_when: PR #13508 merges (before that no such PR can exist). Then build the alarm, or kill it with a stated reason if the operator accepts the silent-unmerged window

origin.ref: lane JC-GIT session_01GxXaAMqxdL3p1XTuRC5mjc; manager review of #13508 head 4ddc26b2b (should-fix)

what: No alarm fires for a set-account-mode PR left OPEN and UNMERGED (review finding on #13508, 2026-09-28, manager session_01KAQRJxRbRwpYTkPgBjNVyQ). Once #13508 lands, a mode flip is a Tier-3 hold PR (branch automation/set-account-mode-<run_id>) that changes nothing until someone merges it. account-mode-verify.yml fires only on the MERGE. So a PR that is never merged reports nothing, and the account silently stays in its old mode. The operator believes it flipped because the system-action issue reported 'PR opened'. Proposed: a scheduled check that lists open PRs whose head matches automation/set-account-mode-* and are older than N minutes (N to be decided; about 60?). For each it sends a send-ping naming the account, the target mode and the PR. Tier 1 (read-only + ping).
